'''Mat Allen Darth And Friends''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Mat Allen]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds90.htm Darth And Friends], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001029114804/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds90.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
